prompts.widget_mode: Write the reply only in show_reply.
prompts.clarify: Ask one short question to clarify, nothing else.

format.table: Use a table where it fits.

one_line.label: Sum it up in one line
one_line.message: Sum it up in one line.

as_prose.label: Write it as plain text
as_prose.message: Write it as plain text, no lists.

not_this.label: Not what I wanted
not_this.message: That's not what I wanted. Ask me one short question to understand what I need.

profile.title: What I learned about you
profile.intro: What your AI assistants know about how you like answers. Change any line: it takes effect on the next reply.

plan_reply.description: Call before every reply. Returns the conversation_id, turn_id and the instruction to follow.

fields.topic: What the request is about, max 15 words, in the user's language
fields.language: ISO 639-1 code of the language of the user's message
fields.needed_words: Words a complete, no-filler answer needs
fields.last_reply_outcome: How the user's latest message reacted to your previous reply
fields.conversation_id: Omit on the first message; reuse the returned value
fields.user_quote: The user's exact words proving the outcome, max 5 words
fields.format_issue: Only when last_reply_outcome is wrong_format: what was wrong
fields.ambiguous: Only when true: the request has several plausible readings
fields.last_reply_words: Fallback mode only: approximate length of your previous reply
fields.assistant_model: First call only: the model answering, if you know it

show_reply.description: Widget mode: write your entire reply here, in Markdown, and nothing in the chat.

record_click.description: Internal to the reply widget. The model must never call this.

report_context.description: Internal to the reply widget. The model must never call this.
